no-restricted-syntax.message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML is banned in this project (HIGH-1). It would render any HTML stored in snapshots.markdown_text or page_title as raw markup, defeating the lib/sanitize.ts persistence-layer protection. If you have a genuine, narrow use case (e.g. rendering trusted, server-built HTML with no user content), discuss with the team first; otherwise render text with {variable} so React escapes it.
